brief.title: Profile a repository
brief.plain_summary: Read one pinned repository snapshot and write a short profile: what it is, who it serves, and how it is built, tested, deployed and paid for.
brief.outcome: A repo-profile noun with cited facts and explicit unknowns, ready for question selection.

repo_snapshot.description: Pin of a noun shaped like template.repo-snapshot: the repository location and exact commit.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

outcome_meanings.profile_ready: The declared nouns were produced and every deterministic acceptance check passed.
outcome_meanings.no_change: The evidence does not justify producing or changing anything. Say why.
outcome_meanings.unknown: The question could not be answered with the permitted inputs. List what is missing and what would resolve it.
outcome_meanings.blocked: A required input, permission or capability is missing. Ask one precise question.

acceptance_checks.check: The snapshot noun's value SHA-256 matched its pin before any file was read.
The profile validates against template.repo-profile's schema.
The profile's commit equals the snapshot's commit.
Every fact has a non-empty evidence reference.
Facts that could not be established are listed as unknown rather than guessed.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: Recheck your grants, read the pinned snapshot noun and verify its value SHA-256 before anything else.
Work from the exact commit in the snapshot. Read files only; this verb does not run repository code.

Record languages, entry points, build and test commands, CI, deployment targets, external services, paid APIs, data stores, license, docs and stated audience. Cite a path, command or source for each fact.
List every fact you could not establish as unknown with a reason. Never guess traffic, revenue or cost.
Keep everything inside the requester's scope. Do not open issues, pull requests, comments, emails or messages to anyone, and do not publish anything.
Write one profile noun create-only, read it back, and return it with its pin.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
preferred: List tracked files and parse manifests before reading individual files.

required_capabilities: read-only access to the pinned repository snapshot
write candidate nouns in the requester's scope

brief.title: Select the questions that apply
brief.plain_summary: Use the profile to choose the few questions from the bank whose answers could change a decision, and say why the others were skipped.
brief.outcome: A review plan listing selected questions with reasons and priorities, and skipped questions with reasons.

brief.title: Investigate one question family
brief.plain_summary: Answer the selected questions of one family with located evidence: confirm the concern, rule it out, or mark it unknown.
brief.outcome: One finding per selected question in the family, each passing the evidence standard's deterministic checks.

required: Verify every pin, then read the family guide for the family parameter and each selected question of that family.

max_options.description: Most fixes to compare in addition to keeping things as they are.
